scenario: [LUNI.8.9]: a value whose type names no unit, such as a dimension-typed slot ([LUNI.7.1]), is in its dimension's base unit. `temp: temperature` holding 293.4 K rounds to 293 K, so `round(r.temp) == 293_kelvin` and the rule logs. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.rlow_6_1_9_in_unit`'s `float64` arm with no unit, the builtin and FN_INT_TO_FLOAT alone.
rules_ds:
schema R scope logical:
    id: String key
    temp: temperature mutable

rule r:
    R r where round(r.temp) == 293_kelvin
->
    log info "base"
